title: Keep the append-only session log as the single source of truth
A registered event vocabulary with a small, stable envelope
One SQLite database per harness home is the session store, behind a narrow interface
Crash safety from transactions, durability from an explicit flush barrier
Do not read upstream format generations; no migration chain
Evolve the schema per event type, not per log
Projections are registered pure folds whose checkpoints commit with the events they reflect
Full-text search is SQLite FTS5 in the same database
Machine state in tables, blobs in files, user configuration in files
The store never repairs meaning; the resuming writer closes an interrupted turn; deletion is added
Immutability by ownership and copying, not by freezing
A line-per-event export format for portability, not for live storage
